parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitIds
parameters.description: The list of organizational unit IDs. The number of IDs in the list cannot exceed 100.

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitName
parameters.description: The name of the organizational unit. An exact match is used for the query.

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitNameStartsWith
parameters.description: The prefix of the name of the organizational unit. A left-side match is used for the query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ParentId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent organizational unit.
